work_unit.title: 实现短期 GitHub 凭证与 UnknownEffect 对账
work_unit.goal: 在执行已批准 PR Action 的最后时刻由 TypeScript facade 解析短期凭证并仅通过已认证内部请求传给 Go；以稳定 Provider marker、显式 effect 状态和 lookup-before-retry 收敛不确定结果，保证同一批准最多产生一个 GitHub PR。

codebase_context.current_gap: The Go GitHub client can create a pull request but receives no short-lived credential from the TypeScript Secret Service. Action execution has requested/approved/executed facts but no durable executing or unknown-effect reconciliation state, so provider success followed by timeout or database failure may be retried blindly.
codebase_context.existing_guards: ActionRequest already binds Target, immutable Submission, acceptance, approval, params hash, repo binding and expected commit. T003 preserves candidate versus human authority and T004 supplies version-bound work results.
codebase_context.ownership: Go Domain API owns ActionRequest, EffectReceipt, reconciliation facts and final execution validation. TypeScript owns secret resolution and may carry the credential only in the authenticated one-shot internal request.

authority_rules: Only the authenticated internal facade request may carry the short-lived GitHub credential; body fields, public routes, domain inputs, receipts, audits, outbox events and Temporal payloads must not contain it.
Every execution revalidates active TargetRevision, immutable Submission and acceptance, ActionApproval, exact params hash, repo binding, expected commit, and requester/approver separation.
A stable provider marker is derived without secrets and is recorded before the provider call.
Retry from unknown_effect must query GitHub by the marker first; found converges to one EffectReceipt, confirmed absent may retry, and inconclusive remains unknown_effect.
No database transaction stays open across a GitHub network call.

tdd_plan.red: Add tests for credential omission from persisted/logged data, missing or malformed internal credential transport, provider timeout before and after creation, connection reset, post-effect database failure, lookup found/absent/inconclusive, duplicate execution, changed params, stale acceptance and cross-Workspace bindings.
tdd_plan.green: Add the minimum ephemeral credential bridge, credential-injected one-shot GitHub client, executing/unknown_effect transitions, stable provider marker, lookup port and reconciliation commands.
tdd_plan.refactor: Keep provider create/lookup behind the GitHub client port and centralize redaction and effect-state transitions after the fault matrix is green.

commands: focused shared/server connector, secret and redaction tests
credential sentinel scan of database facts and captured logs

required_items: ephemeral credential boundary and sentinel non-persistence proof
stable marker and one EffectReceipt proof
params, revision, acceptance, approval and Workspace invalidation proof
real GitHub credential and repository prerequisites for T010

checks: credential cannot enter durable or logged structures
provider call occurs outside database transactions
lookup-found cannot create a second PR
lookup-absent retry preserves the same marker
final receipt is immutable and unique

stop_conditions: The only feasible design persists or logs the GitHub credential.
GitHub lookup cannot identify the canonical marker with adequate certainty.
A provider call would need to occur inside the fact transaction.
Existing ActionRequest or approval facts cannot express safe invalidation without an unplanned destructive migration.
